videos.title: Doctor Who
videos.description: When disaster hits the Titanic, the Doctor uncovers a threat to the whole human race. Battling alongside aliens, saboteurs, robot Angels and a new friend called Astrid, can he stop the Christmas inferno?

videos.title: A Christmas Carol Goes Wrong
videos.description: After last year's hilarious `Peter Pan Goes Wrong', the Olivier Award-winning Mischief Theatre Company return with their take on Dickens' famous festive fable. Blacklisted by the BBC after ruining `Peter Pan', the Cornley Polytechnic Drama Society hijack the jewel of the Christmas schedule, a `live' production of `A Christmas Carol' staged by a professional cast. The Cornley gang try to make the show work on `live' television as they soon realise they are completely out of their depth.

videos.title: Miranda
videos.description: Part 1/2. We find Miranda where we left her, with two proposals, one from Gary and one from Mike. Will she choose one of them, or will she run away from the pressures of relationships and the fear of not coping with being a wife?

videos.title: Miranda
videos.description: Part 2/2. It's the final chance for Miranda to try to learn to accept herself and find contentment. Will it be alone or does she find her one true love? One last chance to hang out with Miranda, Stevie, Penny, Tilly and Gary.

videos.title: Gavin & Stacey
videos.description: Stacey's brother Jason arrives home early, much to Uncle Bryn's horror. Stacey has her hen night and Gavin has two stag nights, the second of which reveals something about Stacey that could jeopardise the whole wedding.

videos.title: Gavin & Stacey
videos.description: The wedding day has finally arrived, but will they go through with it? Will Uncle Bryn finally admit to what happened on the fishing trip and will Nessa do what she knows she must?

videos.title: Man Like Mobeen
videos.description: Mobeen and Nate are just weeks from the end of their sentence, but Mobeen's work as one of the prison's 'Listeners' gets him into trouble with a terrifying inmate from another wing, a man known simply as Megalodon. Megalodon is determined to get a transfer to Mobeen's wing so he can confront him about meddling in his business. Mobeen and Nate also have to deal with prison officer Saj, who's a constant thorn in their side.

videos.title: Man Like Mobeen
videos.description: Mobeen has landed himself in the prison infirmary, where he also has a mission, to befriend a man known as 'Memory Stick' and convince him to hand over vital information. In the infirmary, he also encounters a doctor, Nida, and there's an instant spark between her and Mobeen. Nida also suggests she can help Aqsa with a placement for her medical degree, which she is thrilled with. Aqsa also receives some characteristically unhelpful advice from prison chaplain Uncle Shady.

videos.title: Man Like Mobeen
videos.description: Megalodon is now on Mobeen's wing, and Mobeen must avoid him at all costs, which means trying not to leave his cell. Harper instantly makes Mobeen leave the cell to go and see Dr Nida. Nida now has Aqsa working alongside her.

videos.title: Man Like Mobeen
videos.description: Megalodon throws the prison into a full-blown riot. Mobeen, Nate and Harper split off into different groups. Mobeen is concerned with Dr Nida's safety, while also keen to keep Memory Stick on side.

videos.title: Man Like Mobeen
videos.description: Mobeen's plan to get to Aqsa goes wrong, but before he can accept Uncle Shady's drastic solution, a familiar face shows up with an offer of their own.

videos.title: Two Pints of Lager and a Packet of Crisps
videos.description: Gaz has a health scare and blames Donna. Jonny is so interested that he fails to notice that Janet is having second thoughts about marrying him. David finds a new way to test Louise's commitment.

videos.title: Two Pints of Lager and a Packet of Crisps
videos.description: Janet tries to dump Johnny but is upstaged by some pasties, Louise gets revenge on David, and Donna finds the courage to pursue a new dream.

videos.title: Two Pints of Lager and a Packet of Crisps
videos.description: Jonny finds himself a new girlfriend, Gaz challenges David to a drinking contest for Donna, and a book called 'Piggy Goes Oink' changes Louise's life.

videos.title: Two Pints of Lager and a Packet of Crisps
videos.description: Jonny ruins his first date with Kate by trying too hard to be manly, a big hairy spider upsets Louise's plan to live with Janet, and Gaz bids to become a pop idol.

videos.title: Two Pints of Lager and a Packet of Crisps
videos.description: Janet and Gaz get much closer than they had ever intended, and biscuits improve Jonny and Kate's love life.

videos.title: My Mate's A Bad Date
videos.description: Cardiff based, hopeless romantic Lewis just can't help hearing wedding bells and talking through future life plans on date one, but that's not the only obstacle to him getting a second date.

videos.description: Eve finds herself grappling with the aftermath. Gina's search for answers takes an unexpected turn. Family tensions continue to simmer for the Carters.

videos.title: EastEnders
videos.description: Gina pushes for the truth, whatever the consequences. Emotions run high as old feelings resurface. Linda's loved ones remain concerned about her wellbeing.

videos.title: EastEnders
videos.description: A long-awaited answer leaves tensions at breaking point. Ned's plans hit an unexpected obstacle. Linda opens up about her fears for the future.

videos.title: EastEnders
videos.description: Nicola takes matters into her own hands. Gina faces a difficult decision. Denise's resilience is put to the test.

videos.title: Stacey & Joe
videos.description: Stacey and Joe find a buyer for Pickle Cottage, while fish arrive at the lake and miniature ponies are on the agenda. Zach faces a big test before heading to America.

videos.title: Strike
videos.description: Robin and Strike make a major breakthrough, having eliminated several suspects. Robin's cover is blown, and Strike stays the night at her new flat. Meanwhile, Anomie claims another two victims.

videos.title: Strike
videos.description: The agency is the target of a devastating attack. Strike figures out who killed Edie, and having secured proof, Robin puts herself in danger in order to save lives.

videos.title: Charlie Cooper's Myth Country
videos.description: Keen to escape the trappings of a modern Christmas, Charlie wraps up warm and heads to Devon to start an investigation into alternative winter celebrations. The barrel-burning festival in Devon's Ottery St Mary is held every November.

videos.title: Charlie Cooper's Myth Country
videos.description: Charlie goes in search of Black Shuck, the demon dog of East Anglia. He meets locals who disagree that seeing Shuck brings with it a curse. Keen to capture the beast on camera, he attempts an overnight stakeout, with unexpected consequences.

videos.title: Charlie Cooper's Myth Country
videos.description: Charlie heads to Wiltshire, home to ancient sites such as Stonehenge, Avebury, and the Westbury chalk horse, to try to understand why humans feel the need to leave marks on the landscape.

videos.title: Charlie Cooper's Myth Country
videos.description: Charlie Cooper has always loved the stories of King Arthur, especially the ones about his buried treasures. He digs out his metal detector, says goodbye to his family and embarks on an Arthurian investigation.

videos.title: Top Gear
videos.description: The cars put to the test include the Aston Martin Rapide, the Porsche Panamera Turbo and the Maserati Quattroporte, in a search for the world's greatest four-seat supercar. Richard is also on the test track testing the Chevrolet Camaro SS and Mercedes E63 AMG. There's a double dose of celebrity as 'Harry Potter' star Rupert Grint and F1 ace Rubens Barrichello take their turns as the stars in the Reasonably Priced Car.

videos.title: My Mate's A Bad Date
videos.description: Georgie's best mate Vicky is the ultimate dating ice queen. Vicky's super picky, has a long list of unrealistic criteria for her perfect match, dumps guys for using the wrong emojis, analyses everything they do and walks out of 60% of her dates.

videos.title: The Catch-Up
videos.description: A round-up of the day's news.

videos.title: Horrible Histories
videos.description: A special episode about the great French leader Napoleon Bonaparte, starring Jim Howick. Following Napoleon as he rises from humble beginnings to be the Emperor of France, bashing most of Europe along the way, and ultimately meeting his Waterloo at, well, Waterloo!

videos.title: Horrible Histories
videos.description: The young King Henry VIII struggles with his boring dad Henry VII, before becoming king himself, and going through wives like most people go through toothbrushes! Meanwhile, across the world we meet the great Ottoman leader Suleiman the Magnificent in Turkey.

videos.title: Top Gear
videos.description: Jeremy Clarkson, Richard Hammond and James May attempt to build cool and interesting motorhomes before setting off for a bank holiday weekend in the West Country to see how each of their creations performs in the real world. Meanwhile, Jeremy is also at the test track to test the new Audi R8 V10 Spyder against the latest version of Porsche's enduring 911 Turbo cabriolet.

videos.title: Top Gear
videos.description: Jeremy Clarkson subjects the Škoda Yeti to a remarkably thorough road test, while James May makes a rare visit to the test track in the insane Ariel Atom V8. Meanwhile, Richard Hammond celebrates the incredible evolution of the Porsche 911 by racing a modern Turbo Cabriolet against its oldest relative and the power of gravity. Plus, another celebrity guest takes their turn in the Reasonably Priced Car.

videos.title: Silent Witness
videos.description: When the bones of a young girl are found, everyone but Nikki is convinced it's a teenager who went missing two years ago.

videos.title: Silent Witness
videos.description: Having fallen out both with both the police and Clara's family, Nikki finds herself increasingly alone in her search for the killer.

videos.title: Stacey Dooley
videos.description: Rehab centres are treating some of their youngest-ever and most physically damaged addicts, and ketamine has been their drug of choice. Stacey Dooley gains rare access to a rehab in Stockport and gets to know former users. Many are in chronic pain, and one young man needs bladder reconstruction surgery. Over four months, she follows them through recovery, relationships, setbacks and celebrations.

videos.title: The Young Offenders
videos.description: A not-so-clever plan to earn some extra cash backfires, bringing the lads head-to-head with Sergeant Healy, who has been hot on their heels for some time and is determined to catch them up to no good. They also may have been caught in the act by Principal Walsh's two daughters, Siobhán and Linda, so the lads need to turn on the charm to persuade the girls not to spill the beans, which only serves to further irritate Principal Walsh.

videos.title: The Young Offenders
videos.description: Conor and Jock's friendships with principal Walsh's daughters Linda and Siobhan intensify, causing awkward tension between the lads, the principal, and the girls themselves. Conor and Jock crash a Walsh family barbecue, and principal Walsh's wife Orla is intent on her husband giving the lads a chance: they can't be all that bad, can they?

videos.title: The Young Offenders
videos.description: There's only one thing left for Conor and Jock to do to get Linda and Siobhan to really fall for them: spend a whole day together on a beautiful adventure. A sick day from school is the only way they can do this, leading to various difficulties.

videos.title: Long Story Short
videos.description: Coming-of-age comedy drama set in the annual paranormal festival of a postindustrial town known as the 'Roswell of South Wales'. A shy 17-year-old outsider is marked for 'abduction' as part of the town's terrifying tradition. He must evade capture and make it through the night, navigating love, friendship and events that are beyond explanation.
